items.text: Today, Unity notified developers about a security issue with all Unity apps, advising developers to update their apps for PC and Android. This game has now successfully been updated with the new security patch fixed! :) I am in the process of updating all affected Valorware apps - Thank you!
Toggling between First Person Mode/top down mode will no longer mess up HP Bars
Some ladder collision boxes have been reduced to prevent using them through walls (some may still be able to use through walls, but I tried to focus on the Sequence-breaker ones)
1.170 - 7th January 2025
HP Bars for enemies in First Person mode
First Person mode toggling with button now correctly sets the FirstPersonMode value in config too, to prevent weird toggling bugs
Toggling between First Person mode now points the camera in the direction you were walking
Some small performance updates
Lots of 2player controller reworking to prevent loss of UI control

Lots of online MP control reworking to provide more information about what the other player is doing in some online MP menus, and allow functionality for the client player to leave the game when waiting during those circumstances
Fixed some soft-locking on inviting/losing connection with certain windows open
1.165 - 19th November 2024
Dark chain spell rotation speed reduced a bit, as it's fast rotation speed makes it slightly too OP. It's still very powerful, dont worry!
Blizzard spell size increased a bit to make it more useful
Light Field spell spawn radius tightened to be closer to the player

Light Sky Spikes spell spawn radius tightened to be closer to the player: The following spells have been changed to vary up the spells a bit and try give more control over some. Still working out how best to control them with gamepad, but for now I would advice some of these to be mapped to DPad + shoulder button
Comet spell changed to be directional, random in Arc, with more comets
Earth spikes spell changed to be directional, random in tight Arc
Ice Spikes spell changed to be directional, random in loose Arc, with more spikes
1.164 - November 18th 2024
Attempted to further improve the weird 45degree snapping angle for Gamepad sticks as some people are still having issues
1.163- November 18th

Critical gamepad input fix - I had no idea the controller was locking input to weird 45degree angles until I saw it in a recent review - No idea when this started happening but I have now fixed it - PLEASE let me know on the Forums or Discord if you encounter any issues like this, thank you!
1.162 - 16th November 2024
Removed that little split-second weird white circle on startup
Removed those "Todo" strings with proper names in Network menu when connected
L3/R3 graphics have been added to input icon graphics (for rebinding window)
"Leave Multiplayer" button added to Local MP 2nd player menu (page 2)
Fixed "Confirm" button on controller assigner not properly assigning player 2
Bug Fix - equipment upgrading item requirements weren't checking your inventory properly
Bug Fix - Light armour ranged bonus wasn't working. It's now working, but I have nerfed them a little as they were a bit too high
Balance - Enemy HP attack and magic attack increased
Balance - Hard mode - enemy attack and HP increased
1.161 - 29th October 2024
Camel animation/flip direction fixed - not sure when it stopped working sorry!
Pets Aggro range has been reduced and more centered on the camera, so they will be less likely to run offscreen looking for enemies
Max MP Nerfed
Local MP - 2nd player can now press "Up" in player menu to quick-navigate to the bottom and vice versa
Balance - Enemy HP slight increase
Balance - Enemy Attack slight increase
Balance - Enemy HP HARD MODE - increase
Balance - Enemy HP HARD MODE - Enemy Attack slight increase
Card Game - Online MP - "Use Card Button" now disappears when no longer relevant
Card Game - Online MP - Enemies using status effects now syncs to 2nd player
Card Game - If controller disconnects whilst playing, you can now reconnect the controller successfully
Card Game - Local MP - Fixed - If p2 leaves whilst in control, control will now be given back to p1
Fishing Game - Online MP - Boss HP Bars removed when changing scene
1.160 - 20th October 2024
Sharper graphics - I accidentally had the game rendering in lower quality than intended, sorry! Please enjoy sharper graphics :')
Performance update - I've been working on the Switch and Mobile ports and I've managed to uncover some big performance updates which should hopefully transfer into the PC Version!
Bug Fix - First person mode - mouse rotation was tied to framerate fluctuations, should be fine now

Water on "low graphics" mode has been improved: Please let me know if there's any new bugs, especially with NPCs. I think everything should be fine but as part of the optimization, NPC behaviour has changed slightly. Thank you!
1.158 - 16th October 2024
QUICK SELL Feature added to shops! Middle mouse button, or Y/Triangle on gamepad.

BUY-BACK Feature added to shops! If you accidentally sell an item, you can buy it back for the same price you sold it. Navigate to the last page(s) of the shop! Please note, the list is reset every time you change map, and is NOT saved- so your SOLD items will be gone for good if you change map or quit out of the game!
Bug Fix - "Sell" input help added to pop-up window when able to sell items (previously showed "use/equip")
Rebindable button added for Quick Sell
Rebindable button added for Take All: As these are quite new systems with a lot of complexity, please do let me know if you experience any issues!
1.157 -15th October 2024
CARD GAME - Fixed "X attack random enemies card"
All 2D spell opacity has been reduced, as they were a bit too visually strong. This is mostly noticeable in AOE type spells
Bug Fix - transferring an equipped item to storage/other chest did not unequip the item
Bug Fix - "Transfer" now appears instead of "use" when using gamepad and highlighting item in a container
"Quick Transfer" - you can transfer items from YOUR inventory to storage/other chest from a click of a button (middle mouse on PC, Y/triangle on gamepad)

Mouse icons added to item window for extra help: Thats it for now, I've nearly completed a "Quick-sell" button - but I need to include a buy-back system at the same time ideally just incase. Hopefully I can provide this soon!
1.156 - 14th October 2023

'Change appearance' button added to player menu, so you can change your hair/skin color after game creation. This was mostly an issue for Local Multiplayer!: The above took a bit longer than expected sorry, I can hopefully focus on some bugs and QoL stuff next! Thank you everyone!
1.155 - 12th October 2024

Commands added to change easy/normal/hard mode midgame. Please note you may need to change map to see the effects of these. When IN GAME, go to Options->Command, then enter "easymode" or "normalmode" or "hardmode"
Allow "Paste" on all string input windows to allow for easier input for commands, for example
EXP nerf a little more (just a small one!)
EXP for hard mode has been nerfed somewhat, for people that are still saying EXP is too easy
Hair color finally working in game: I am working on changing appearance mid-game, which is especially useful for local MP - but I ran out of time today sorry. hopefully tomorrow!
1.154 - 11th October 2024

Significant Performance increase on World Map. This will hopefully help keep the framerate at 60 especially on Steam Deck - and lower end PCs. I've noticed an improvement on my Steam Deck already, world map was 50-60fps now running at 60fps solid seemingly!: Please let me know if any weirdness arises from this, including from NPCs or some effects! But it SHOULD all be good!
1.152 - 8th October 2024
Healing spells and regen sound effects modified to remove some of the high frequency, to prevent uncomfort with headphones: (Sorry just a small one, working on more requests at the moment!)
1.151 - 7th October 2024
Pet (S) items now will have a chance to drop from higher level monsters too, to hopefully provide more S drops (specifically for Talon and Bone). Please let me know if this helps!
Card Game achievement "Beat all card game missions" should hopefully be fixed
1.150 - 7th October 2024

Pets - there was an old multiplier that was affecting pets in a strange way when reloading. This has been removed and pets have been buffed a little to compensate. Depending on your pet's stats, you may see +/- stats from this update, but the new fix is how the pets were intended to work.
Card Game - Online MP fixed Attack mods not showing, and shield mods not showing
Card Game - Fixed the X attack cards not showing damage multipliers. They seem a bit OP so I'll have to monitor these

Magic wands significant nerf due to how OP they were. It turns out they were getting benefits from previous patches where I increased melee damage. They were never meant to be this powerful. This nerf is more noticeable at higher levels, and may still not even be nerfed enough!
1.149 - 5th October 2024

Online MP Crititcal fix - reworked how "friendly/non-freindly" enemies work so hopefully bosses that were out of sync, will now be in sync. Note I had to change a lot of code here that potentially could even affect single player mode, so PLEASE let me know if anyone finds any enemies/friendlies that are behaving weird
Online MP "miniboss" red circle synced better, before it was on some enemies that weren't actually minibosses
1.148 - 5th October 2024
Fishing game re-balance attempt - higher level enemies have less HP and Attack. Players have higher HP and attack at higher levels
1.147 - 4th October 2024
Fixed respec buttons not being selectable with Gamepad
Fixed gates & doors blocking arrows/spells when they're open!
1.146 - 4th October 2024
Respec Attributes and Abilities buttons added to player menu (page 2)
+5 button added to Attributes window
Pet "buff" items have been fixed, if you've used some before you may notice varying pet damage depending on what/how much you used!
Fishing Game - Enemy HP reduced and Boss HP reduced further
1.145 - 4th October 2024

Pet HP Bars added to UI in first person mode. They can also be enabled in Top-down view in Options->Graphics->"Pet HP Bars in UI" if you prefer to see them there: Preview image: https://imgur.com/a/d2Uy2gQ
1.144 - 3rd October 2024
Pet L buff food added to Zarahakul shop

Different Mouse and Gamepad cursors added to Input Menu. Change the appearance and size of these from the Options->input menu. These took a lot longer time to implement than I expected unfortunately, so unless it's an emergency I really politely ask that you don't ask for more/varying cursors as I need to focus on adding some gameplay related things next, thank you for your understanding <3 (changing to custom colours is also not possible)
1.143 - 3rd October 2024
Some missing items have been added to Alchemy, i.e. small consumables such as Energy Drink, EyeDrops etc.
Meal Of Dawn food item added to Zarahakul general supplies shop
3 Merchants added to END of the last end-game dungeon, selling rings/necklaces/relics, for those who want to complete the item journal.
1.142 - 2nd October 2024
Pet evolution items added to Alchemy. Turn S->M, M->L etc! (NOT for monster goo, I want to tie this to exploration)
Pet evolution items droprate adjusted to hopefully monsters drop more variation
Pet EXP nerfed a little as they are levelling a bit too fast at the moment
Alchemy mastery reduced from 2,000 to 60 items
1.141 - 1st October 2024
Monster Goo M should drop sooner in overall game
Vampyre enemies has been added to Gaol of the Broken
Sescern "bloody letter" treasure chest fixed for those missing the item (For Alexe quest)
Card Game "unlock all champions" achievement changed to "Get all champions to level 3"
Fishing Game "unlock all champions" achievement changed to "Get all champions to level 10"
1.140 - 1st October 2024
OPTIMIZE - Removed some debug log warnings so hopefully the game will run smoother, particularly those who experienced slowdowns with water (maybe? Hopefully? Please tell me?)
MELEE - Damage from attributes increased
ABILITY COINS - Doubled the amount of ability coins gained from Orbs. I grossfully underestimated the number of coins in the game so this change is more appropriate.
ABILITY COINS - Gave existing players the amount of coins owed to them from the above boost, enjoy^
PETS - Changed Monster Taming multiplier, previously only 10% of all monster taming was affecting stats. Now fully unlocked to 100% to reflect the investment and rewards Monster Tamers mode
PETS - Exp split between pets now disabled, pets will level up the same regardless of how many are out, due to complaints and slow leveling when too many out

PETS - As a result of the above pet exp, attack and HP have been nerfed to try to compensate for how much more powerful they will end up being - we still may get OP pets but I'm not sure yet - Just want to get the system working fully as intended and we can tweak from there!
FISHING GAME - reduced BOSS hp down by approx 25%
FIXED - Access to East outside area in Dragon Fortress
CHANGE - Melee small damage boost. Some Melee +% may be added to armour in future, I'm still just assessing. Thank you!
1.132 - 30th September 2024

FIXED - Creating a new game if coming back from other menu will now properly reset the maps collected so far. If this happened to you, I don't think there's any harm anyway, thank you!: I'm working hard on some other fixes and improvements, but just wanted to push the above out to prevent confusion!
1.131 - 30th September 2024
FIXED - Ring of the nimble… omg lol. Fixed it endlessly stacking. Also buffed it a small amount so it's effects are more noticeable when wearing 2+
BALANCE - Reduced Monster evolution XL Requirements for pets
BALANCE - Increase droprate for XL items
FIXED - Ring of the nimble, wasn't adding movement speed. Added it, but nerfed % as they STACK
MELEE - Reworked formula so it more closely represents "Attack Up" passive abilities and buffs
MAIC - Similar to above but perhaps the lower level isn't quite there yet, but still should be improved!
RANGED - Untouched for now, ran out of time sorry. Will monitor the situation…!
PETS - Fixed issue where some pets could not be evolved
PETS - Reduced level requirement for evolution by approx 40%
Hunter Journal - changed 1000 each monster kills to 70 kills, much more reasonable lol
Fishing Game - level max raised from 30 to 40: I'm still working my way through the lists of suggestions, thank you
1.129 - 30th September 2024
Critical fix for online multiplayer - changing certain maps (e.g. collapsing cave) will now bring your friend along with you!
Fishing Game - Overall Roll time cooldown reduced
Card Game - Tower maps floor numbers reduced significantly (max 25 reduced to 8 for example)

Card Game - Enemy HP, Attack and Shield at higher levels Nerfed: I'm working on some main game bugs for the next patch but just wanted to get the above out before, as it may take me some time to work on the base game^ Thank you everyone for the feedback!
1.127- 29th September 2024
HP Bars on map should hopefully always see the correct color when playing co-op (green = friendly, red = enemy)
Fishing Game - Boss HP Bars fixed so they disappear after boss defeated, and made smaller overall
Card game - fixed "Random enemies" card from attacking the same one twice. I'm still investigating cases where it supposedly hits "None at all", can anyone please let me know if that happens?

Card game - mouse targeting hitboxes adjusted a bit to prevent weird situations where mouse targets on/off quickly: *Coming soon* I do want to add a custom mouse icon as I've had a lot of requests for that, but I need to approach that delicately to prevent annoying more people, and maybe add an option to tweak it too. It will hopefully be coming soon, thank you and sorry!
I'm so sorry, I messed up the dialogue in previous patch for all languages. It should be fixed now!
Fixed Quest Map showing incorrect ladder icons when viewing quest map from within a dungeon
Fixed - Chellen Crypt map icon for Chella Quest
Fixed - Monster nature label not being updated when changing pages between pets
Fixed - Pets show nicknames in Level up window
Fixed - Pets critical error, their HP suddenly drops every now and then- especially when leveling up Monster Taming- Should hopefully see lets pets dying randomly now

Magic - Attack and MP reduced a bit due to how powerful they are now (especially later on) (please dont worry about "magic attack" for spells, you'll be doing powerful dmg anyway a bit further into the game)
Card Game fix - Relics that affect AP are now shown on online multiplayer
1.111 - 28th September 2024

HUGE MAGIC Rework! A lot of the "random position" type spells have now been moved in much closer to the player, and the power split between each one has been increased (it was too diluting before) This should hopefully mean spells feel much more impactful!
EXP/Skill EXP Items fixed - mostly food items, were giving severe low EXP instead of +amount
FIXED - Card Game - Champion HP should now perfectly sync, including when got a +MaxHP Relic

NEW FEATURE - Fishing Game - Now your worms can ROLL! Including, i-Frames! This is to hopefully address the balance issues and giving the players more agency and strategy to deal with oncoming hordes of FISH. Diff worms have diff cooldowns for Roll.
CHANGE - Fishing Game - Higher end Enemies have slightly less HP
1.109 - 27th September 2024
Lava in Castle of Maltyr and other dungeons Fixed
Chests near Claus and Cold fortress fixed
Frozen Temple missing wall crack preventing access to left bit of dungeon fixed
Mana potions added to Alchemy
1.108 - 27th September 2024
Elemental magic attacks increased by approx +25-30% damage
Total MP increased from stats
EXP curve adjusted a bit, people leveling up a bit too fast
Crafting Skill EXP needed to level up made easier
Crafting Item requirements reduced
"Scrap" item increased spawn rate
Camel quest actually takes your 50k (Enjoy your free camel before :P )
Healing spells increased to what should hopefully be "normal"
Pets MAX HP increased
Card Game - Enemy HP at high levels reduced
Pet dmg increased

URGENT MAGIC rebalance - So i messed up the healing and found out its because it's linked to elemental attacks too. I've had to do some quite major adjusting to the magic system, which means you will see different magic coming from your spells. Some may be bigger, some lower. I've tried to lessen high lvl player magic whilst boosting low level, as there was a huge gap (high lvl doing >900k dmg) I'd like a fresh magic start from here and see what you think. Sorry for the inconvenience
1.105 - 27th September 2024
FIXED - Summoning Skill added to skill menu
FIXED - Monster Taming skill added to skill menu, and now is more functional
CHANGE - Player MAX HP increased a bit
CHANGE - Player MAX MP increased for later lvls by a significant amount
CHANGE - Healing Circle AOE size increased to make it actually useful
BALANCE - Melee dmg increase
CHANGE - You get Monster Taming skill everytime your pets get EXP. More pets = more skil exp
CHANGE - Monster taming evo items droprate small increase
CHANGE - Monster Taming also adds more Pet EXP

CHANGE - Monster taming evolution items droprate affected by Monster Taming Skill (egg rates not affected because i think its harder to get them at the start anyway, and you will probs end up with too many by the end anyway)
CLARIFY - The Monster taming skill WAS actually contributing to Pet Attack, defence, HP, but only through items (and maybe not by much). Skill has been added
CHANGE - Card game high lvl enemies damage reduced significantly under 3 figures
CHANGE - Card game high lvl enemies shield reduced under 3 figures
1.104 - 27th September 2024
FIXED - Martyr's Castle ladder bugs and LAVA fix
BALANCE - Ranged combat nerfed again especially at higher levels. I keep getting mixed feedback on this so I'm struggling to balance
BALANCE - Pet egg rate dropped a TINY bit to compensate for too much droprate prev patch

BALANCE - Pet EXP needed to level up lowered a bit (so now should be slightly faster levelling): I've just woke up so I'm trying to get through some messages and other things, thank you for the patience!
Just a small one before I go to sleep
BALANCE - Pets - Evo item drop rate increased quite a lot, and you get more when they do
BALANCE - Pets - Eggs item drop rate increased a bit
BALANCE - Pets - nerfed their attack a little, will have to see how it goes. I need to read a bit more feedback properly when I'm less tired
1.102 - 26th September 2024
FIXED - Controller sensitivity issue when playing over 60fps
FIXED - Card Game sometimes missing map unlocks
BALANCE - Crafting - Item drops increased from monsters
BALANCE - Crafting - EXP Increased when crafting
BALANCE - Combat - Ranged nerfed a fair amount
BALANCE - Combat - Melee attack increased a small amount
BALANCE - Combat - Magic increased a small amount
1.101 - 26th September 2024
ADDED - Finally, map scrolling! Mouse/KB: Scrollwheel & WASD, Gamepad: LB/RB & RightStick. Not rebindable at the moment but will do for now!
CHANGE - FishingGame - Worm speed Increase
CHANGE - FishingGame - Brute HP small Increase
CHANGE - FishingGame - High lvl Enemies slowed down movement speed
CHANGE - FishingGame - Higher lvl Enemies HP reduce
CHANGE - FishingGame - Higher lvl Enemies Attack reduce
1.10 - 26th September 2024
FIXED - Hotbar binding with Gamepad Dpad not messing with cursor movement
FIXED - "Reach Kreyshore" achievement
FIXED - World Map icons showing, sorry I didn't realize they weren't!
FIXED - Achievements for completing Dungeons

FIXED - "Magic Attack" removed from skills as it's not actually being used (Magic buffing skill still is currently not leveling though, but it only would contribute a small amount - will try fix soon)
CHANGE - Fishing game yield increased
CHANGE - Fishing game exp from losing increased
1.09 - 26th September 2024
CHANGE - Magic spell damage increased a little
FIXED - Fishing spot near Braley was unlocking the wrong missions (interact with it again)
FIXED - Fast travel achievement should now pop (hopefully!)
FIXED - Ladder in Sescern
FIXED - Ladders in Agaria, sorry - there were 1 too many ladders and I muddled them up.: Rotherperry ladder no longer exists
FIXED - Crafting using Monster Goo M, for real this time
CHANGE - Card game EXP increased to respect player time more
CHANGE - Card game enemy damage and HP reduced
CHANGE - Card game player HP increased per level
CHANGE - Card game added "Max" floor level so you can see your progress, hopefully to incentivise not giving up - you're nearly there!
CHANGE - Card game, quitting will silently give you your EXP so far (although this might not be visible if you didnt level up).
CHANGE - Card game - max attack quantity from enemy reduced from 4 to 3. To help manage damage using protect
FIXED - Camel gate not unlocking
FIXED - Kelan gate not unlocking

^ Really sorry about these, it may be that they opened when you did some other different action by now, but if they're still not open when they SHOULD be, stand next to the gate and option Options->Command type in opengate This should be fixed for anyone that hasn't reached it yet though
CHANGE - Bow damage from DEX nerfed a little
CHANGE - Dagger attack increased by skill
FIXED - Some UI issues for local Multiplayer
FIXED - Some overworld orbs have been fixed
FIXED - extra camel bug from 1.04. The Camel should ONLY be accessible after doing the Camel quest
FIXED - Rothperry Agaria ladder
FIXED - Crafting "medium" difficulty items had wrong Monster Goo requirement

FIXED - Camel unlocking too early (after riding a minecart). This was unintended, YOU MUST DO THE CAMEL QUEST to unlock the Camel! Stop cheating! :D Please Note- If you unlocked the Camel legitimately, you must go back and speak to it to unlock it again, just like IRL.
FIXED - CardGame - Healer 25% dmg to all fixed
FIXED - Sodden Lair ladder bug taking you back to Agaria
CHANGE - Movement speed increased a bit due to complaints :)
FIXED - CardGame - Enemies attack doesn't get affected by player Relic's anymore
CHANGE - CardGame - Rebalanced a little and keep more EXP if you lose the run
CHANGE - Easy mode and Hard mode rebalanced, people said Hard Mode wasn't hard enough
1.02 - 25th September 2024
FIXED - Key rebinds not showing the correct icons during rebind (LOL)
FIXED - Pet buff "HP" items now useable
CHANGE - the "notification" area blur background in top left disappears when not in use

COMMAND - Respec abilities and attributes by using the Options->commands… spoilers! Please don't use these too often as it can ruin the fun of discovery: respecatt - Respec player 1 attribute points: respecab - Respec player 1 abilities & coins: respecatt2 - Respect player 2 attribute points: respecab2 - Respec player 2 abilities & coins

Thank you so much for supporting during launch! I'm a little overwhelmed right now and had some great suggestions, I'll be trying to add and fix as much as possible asap. I've done a little quick update with some things I thought were easy to fix, here it is! I'm working on the next patch now :)
1.01 - 25th September 2024
FIXED - First Person mode: Weapon not updating if you unequip weapon
FIXED - Card game "X Attack all enemies" been fixed
CHANGE - world map bloom reduced (please let me know if it's still not enough)
CHANGE - Fishing game rebalance to make more manageable (please let me know if it's still not enough)
CHANGE - Fishing game max level increased to 30
